item.title: A Decentralized, Trusted MCP Runtime: Architecture and Implementation
item.description: 中文版是这篇文章的默认版本。 阅读中文版 → This English page stays available at this URL; the Chinese version is the one we maintain first. In one line: treat a tool as a content-addressed artifact, run it inside a sandbox, and keep an identity behind it — only then does “trusted” mean anything. That is the architecture; the second half of this article is the implementation. 1. The problem: an agent’s tools are black boxesAn agent’s capability is not bounded by its model.
